entries.title: Custom API models that can read pictures now get them
entries.body: When you save a custom API, Save now checks whether each of its models can read a picture. A model that can shows Reads pictures beside Ready, and gets the pictures you attach and the screenshots a crewmate takes. Other models get a short note in place of each picture, as before, and Save still succeeds. Save a custom API you added earlier again to check its models.

picture.alt: The saved custom model shows Reads pictures beside Ready in Intelligence
